focus: Observable Plot text, stacking, transforms, and responsive text
noveltyJustification: Current Plot 0.6.17 docs verify text/direct-label guidance, stack semantics, and optional/composable transforms; discussion 2105 supports ResizeObserver plus rerender but not the stronger claim that no static responsive-text solution exists. The pinned corpus matches the static contract-compatible subset and leaves C1 as a verification gap.
keyQuestions: What remaining Observable Plot claims are current?
Which Plot capabilities are represented by the pinned static corpus?
answeredQuestions: Plot recommends direct text labels when appropriate, has no automatic labeling, and treats wrapping as approximate unless explicit newlines are used.
stackY/stackX produce lower and upper positions and may be implicit for areaY/barY/rectY.
Plot transforms are optional, composable data-shaping operations; data may be derived outside Plot.
A Plot maintainer recommends ResizeObserver and rerendering for responsive container width; discussion 2105 does not prove a universal no-static-answer limitation.
ruledOutDirections: Treating a conversational discussion as a versioned API guarantee.
Adding Plot runtime transforms or ResizeObserver to the no-runtime templates.
